description: C60 — 马象互补，分工覆盖

intro.popup_en: Piece Coordination, Lesson 2: Knights and bishops have different strengths. Knights control fixed squares and can maneuver in closed positions; bishops control open diagonals. Use them complementarily rather than duplicating their roles.
intro.popup:
子力协调第2课
马和象有不同的特长
马善守封闭格，象善控开放线
二者不要重叠，要互补！

outro.popup_en: Complementary roles are the foundation of piece coordination: the knight controls key squares while the bishop controls diagonals.
outro.popup:
总结：马象互补是子力协调的基础
马守格子，象守斜线，分工明确

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center and opens a diagonal for the bishops.
moves.popup:
e4开局
占中心，开象的线路

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central occupation.
moves.popup:
e5对称
黑方占中心

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops a knight. Knights can jump in closed positions; this one controls e5 and d4.
moves.popup:
Nf3马出动
🐴 马的特点：善跳封闭格
马在f3控制e5和d4

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and protects e5.
moves.popup:
Nc6
黑方马出动，保护e5

moves.popup_en: Bb5 develops the bishop, which controls open diagonals and pins Nc6, indirectly influencing d5. The bishop attacks along lines while the knight controls fixed squares.
moves.popup:
Bb5象出动
🏹 象的特点：善射开放斜线
Bb5牵制Nc6，间接控d5
注意：象在斜线上射击，马守固定格子

moves.popup_en: ...a6 challenges the bishop and asks it to choose a retreat square.
moves.popup:
a6逼迫象表态
黑方问：你的象到底退哪里？

moves.popup_en: Ba4 retreats while continuing to control the c6-d7 line. The bishop's diagonal pressure complements Nf3's control of e5 without duplicating its role.
moves.popup:
Ba4象暂退
激活：象继续控制c6-d7线
协调：Nf3（马守e5格）+ Ba4（象守斜线）互不干扰

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops Black's second minor piece and attacks e4.
moves.popup:
Nf6出动
黑方第2轻子，攻击e4

moves.popup_en: O-O activates the rook on f1 and prepares Re1 to pressure the e-file.
moves.popup:
O-O易位
激活：Rf1进入游戏
计划：Re1压e列

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops and protects Black's king.
moves.popup:
Be7守备
黑方象保护王

moves.popup_en: Re1! White places a rook on the e-file. The rook coordinates with Nf3 and Ba4, creating a central pressure axis.
moves.popup:
Re1！车激活
激活：车进入e列
协调：Re1（重子）+ Nf3+Ba4（轻子）协调
计划：e列是白方的压力轴线

moves.popup_en: ...b5 counterattacks on the queenside and forces the bishop to retreat again.
moves.popup:
b5黑方反击
黑方翼兵推进，逼象再退

moves.popup_en: Bb3! The bishop reaches an active square, controlling the d5 and f7 diagonals, while Nf3 controls e5 and d4. The bishop works along diagonals; the knight guards key squares.
moves.popup:
Bb3象最终归位
激活：象在b3最佳位置
协调：Bb3（象控d5+f7斜线）+ Nf3（马控e5格）
🏹 象控斜线：b3-f7整条对角线
🐴 马守格子：Nf3守e5和d4

moves.popup_en: ...d6 reinforces Black's center.
moves.popup: d6黑方巩固中心

moves.popup_en: c3 supports a future d4 advance, after which White may place a knight on d4.
moves.popup:
c3巩固
激活：为d4做准备
协调：c3后d4推进，马进d4

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king.
moves.popup: O-O黑方易位

moves.popup_en: h3 prevents ...Bg4 from pinning Nf3 and preserves the knight's role in White's coordination.
moves.popup:
h3预防
防止Bg4牵制Nf3
保护马的协调位置

moves.popup_en: ...Na5 attacks the bishop on b3 and seeks to exchange it.
moves.popup:
Na5黑方攻击b3象
黑方想换掉白方Bb3

moves.popup_en: Bc2 retreats to a secure square and controls the e4 diagonal. Together with Nbd2, the bishop and knight establish a new division of roles.
moves.popup:
Bc2象退守
激活：象到c2
协调：Bc2（象控e4对角线）+ Nbd2（马守中心格）
新的马象分工已建立！

moves.popup_en: ...c5 advances and opens the c-file for Black's counterplay.
moves.popup:
c5黑方推进
黑方打开c列反击

moves.popup_en: d4! White opens the d-file and activates the bishop on c2. After the advance, Nbd2 can join the center.
moves.popup:
d4中心推进！
激活：打开d列，激活Bc2象
计划：d4推进后Nbd2进入中心

moves.popup_en: ...Qc7 defends and prepares ...cxd4.
moves.popup:
Qc7黑方后守备
准备...cxd4

moves.popup_en: Nbd2! The b1-knight finally joins the game. White's knights control e5, d4, c4, and e4, while Bc2 controls the e4-h7 diagonal. Three pieces complement one another across the center and both colors of squares.
moves.popup:
Nbd2！马象互补完成！
激活：b1马终于激活
协调体系最终形成：
🐴 Nf3（控e5/d4格）+ Nbd2（控c4/e4格）
🏹 Bc2（控e4/h7斜线）
三子互补，覆盖白格和黑格！
